name: JPY Coin v1
oneLiner: JPYC v1 is the legacy prepaid-payment yen token series from JPYC Inc., predating the funds-transfer-token migration to the current JPYC contracts.
collateral: Japanese-yen reserve assets held for the legacy prepaid-payment JPYC v1 token series
pegMechanism: Prepaid-payment instrument under Japan's Payment Services Act: yen deposited in advance is issued 1:1 as JPYC v1 tokens backed by JPYC Inc. yen reserves. Tokens are non-refundable to cash by design and usable only for payments and free balance transfers; new issuance ended 1 June 2025 ahead of migration to the redeemable funds-transfer-token JPYC.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

reserves.name: JPY reserve assets for legacy JPYC v1

notices.title: Legacy token series
notices.message: JPYC v1 is tracked separately from the current JPYC funds-transfer-token deployment.

mintAuthority.summary: JPYC v1 is a non-upgradeable legacy ERC-20 ('JPYC is ERC20, owned') with an owner-restricted mint(address,uint256) function; JPYC Inc. as contract owner is the sole minter against yen reserves.

controls.label: JPYC v1 owner/minter
controls.evidence: Verified source on Etherscan shows the v1 contract is 'JPYC is ERC20, owned' exposing an owner-restricted mint(address,uint256); the single owner (JPYC Inc.) controls all minting. Non-upgradeable, no proxy.

review.evidence: Etherscan-verified source for the JPYC v1 legacy contract (0x2370f9d5...594cd53) shows an 'owned' ERC-20 with an owner-gated mint function; JPYC Inc. is the FSA-regulated issuer holding the owner/minter role. No permissionless mint path exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Owner() address was not read live on-chain in this pass; classification rests on the Etherscan-verified 'owned' source exposing the owner-gated mint function.
unresolvedQuestions: Read owner() live on Ethereum, Polygon, and Gnosis to resolve the current JPYC v1 owner address and confirm it is the JPYC Inc. issuer key or a Safe/multisig.
